$comment: Coming Soon page copy. Editable content — safe for a CMS. This is the SHARED framing only: each page's own heading and standfirst come from the matching nav item in nav.json (its `label` and `desc`), which is why every menu row already reads as a page title. Change a nav label and the page heading follows. `meanwhile` and `actions` hrefs point back at the homepage with a leading slash so they work from any depth of sub-route.

content.fallbackDesc: A dedicated page for this is on the way.
content.body: Our team is putting this page together right now — the strategy, the proof and the detail it deserves. It will be live shortly.
